questions.question: If ‘P’ stands for ‘×’, ‘Q’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘R’ stands for ‘−’ and ‘S’ stands for ‘+’, then the resultant of which of the following would be 57?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

According to the question, the letters are interchanged as follows:

 
 

 Original Letter
 P
 Q
 R
 S
 
 

 New Symbol
 ×
 ÷
 −
 +
 
 

 

**1) (160 Q 10) R (30 P 2) R (16 Q 4) S 45**

⇒ (160 ÷ 10) − (30 × 2) − (16 ÷ 4) + 45

⇒ 16 − 60 − 4 + 45

⇒ −44 − 4 + 45

⇒ −48 + 45 = −3 (Incorrect)

**2) (160 Q 10) R (30 Q 2) S (16 P 4) R 45**

⇒ (160 ÷ 10) − (30 ÷ 2) + (16 × 4) − 45

⇒ 16 − 15 + 64 − 45

⇒ 1 + 64 − 45

⇒ 65 − 45 = 20 (Incorrect)

**3) (160 Q 10) S (30 P 2) R (16 P 4) S 45**

⇒ (160 ÷ 10) + (30 × 2) − (16 × 4) + 45

⇒ 16 + 60 − 64 + 45

⇒ __**76 − 64**__ + 45

⇒ __**12 + 45**__

⇒ 57 (Correct)

**4) (160 R 10) S (30 Q 2) S (16 Q 4) R 45**

⇒ (160 − 10) + (30 ÷ 2) + (16 ÷ 4) − 45

⇒ 150 + 15 + 4 − 45

⇒ 169 − 45 = 124 (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All cages are nests.

Some nests are houses.

No house is a den.

Conclusions:

(I): No cage is a den.

(II): Some houses are cages.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6df8e1f3399af829e9833d7c064c693d0b3c1dc55d6cc3baca673384c54bc35.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): No cage is a den → False (As, there is no direct relation betweem them)

(II): Some houses are cages → False (As, there is no direct relation betweem them)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

PMS_ _ P_ _ TV _ M_TVPM _ _ V
questions.solution:
Given: PMS_ _ P_ _ TV _ M_TVPM _ _ V

**1) TVMSPTSS** → P M S __**T V**__ P __**M S**__ T V __**P**__ M __**T**__ T V P M __**S S**__ V

Does not follow the PMSTV logic.

**2) MVTSPSST** → P M S __**M V**__ P __**T S**__ T V __**P**__ M __**S**__ T V P M __**S T**__ V 

Does not follow the PMSTV logic.

**3) TVMSPSST** → P M S __**T V**__ / P __**M S**__ T V/ __**P**__ M __**S**__ T V / P M __**S T**__ V

Logic followed is the repeating block PMSTV

**4) TMVSPSST** → P M S __**T M**__ P __**V S**__ T V __**P**__ M __**S**__ T V P M __**S T**__ V

 Does not follow the PMSTV logic.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
